query:
-- Plantes : état des QIDs
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_plants,
  SUM(wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL AND wikidata_qid != '') as with_qid,
  SUM(wikidata_qid IS NULL OR wikidata_qid = '') as without_qid,
  ROUND(SUM(wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL AND wikidata_qid != '') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as pct_with_qid
FROM plants;

-- Molécules : état des QIDs
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_molecules,
  SUM(wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL AND wikidata_qid != '') as with_qid,
  SUM(wikidata_qid IS NULL OR wikidata_qid = '') as without_qid,
  ROUND(SUM(wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL AND wikidata_qid != '') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as pct_with_qid
FROM molecules;
